migrations.name: core-0005_identity_providers.sql
migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

migrations.name: core-0017_owner_signin.sql
migrations.sql:
-- One-time owner sign-in links minted by `rer signin` with the deployment's own
-- Cloudflare credentials, written straight into this table through the D1 API.
-- Apply as a NEW numbered migration under the seed's next unused number; never
-- rewrite an applied migration. Additive only. token_hash is the SHA-256 of the
-- link token (owner-signin-grant.mjs); the token itself is never stored.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_owner_signins (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES oa_operators(id), operator_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, consumed_at INTEGER
);

migrations.name: core-0018_access_codes.sql
migrations.sql:
-- IDV-003: a sender-set access code per recipient, entered before the document opens.
-- code_hash is keyed with the installation's SESSION_SECRET; the code itself is never stored.
-- passed_token is the link token hash the code was entered on, so a reissued link asks again.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iw_access_codes (
 envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES iw_envelopes(id), signer INTEGER NOT NULL,
 code_hash TEXT NOT NULL, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, passed_token TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(envelope_id,signer)
);

migrations.name: core-0019_member_roles.sql
migrations.sql:
-- ACCESS-001 / ADMIN-001: Inkwell's role for a Base `member`. A sender prepares, sends and voids the envelopes they
-- created and sees only those; a viewer reads every envelope. A member with no row is a viewer, the read-only
-- authority every member had before these roles existed. Owners and admins set it.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS iw_member_roles (
 operator_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES oa_operators(id),
 role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('sender','viewer')),
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL
);

migrations.sql:
-- ADMIN-004 / SEND-001: versioned per-source send policies. Every save appends an immutable version that keeps the
-- settings it replaced; the current policy of a source is its highest version, and a source never saved uses the built-in
-- default (version 0). Only the account scope exists until groups and profiles ship (ADMIN-002, ADMIN-008).
CREATE TABLE iw_send_policy_versions (
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0),
  mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('off','person','autonomous')),
  templates TEXT,
  require_internal_approval INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(require_internal_approval IN (0,1)),
  deferred_release INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(deferred_release IN (0,1)),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL,
  at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT,
  before_value TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(scope,source,version),
  CHECK(source<>'ad_hoc' OR mode<>'autonomous')
);
CREATE TRIGGER iw_send_policy_versions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON iw_send_policy_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Send policy versions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER iw_send_policy_versions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON iw_send_policy_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Send policy versions are append-only'); END;

-- Private, installation-local transport custody; never export credentials, codes or links.
CREATE TABLE iw_sms (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 envelope_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 signer INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('code','invitation','followup')),
 recipient TEXT NOT NULL,
 recipient_email TEXT NOT NULL,
 token_hash TEXT,
 code_generation INTEGER,
 body TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','sending','sent','failed','uncertain','cancelled')),

 provider_message_id TEXT,

);
CREATE INDEX iw_sms_pending ON iw_sms(state,envelope_id);
CREATE TRIGGER iw_sms_closed AFTER UPDATE OF data ON iw_envelopes
WHEN json_extract(NEW.data,'$.status')!='awaiting_signature' BEGIN
 UPDATE iw_sms SET state='cancelled',body='' WHERE envelope_id=NEW.id AND state='pending';
END;
CREATE TRIGGER iw_sms_grant_revoked AFTER UPDATE OF state ON iw_followup_grants
WHEN NEW.state!='active' BEGIN
 UPDATE iw_sms SET state='cancelled',body='' WHERE envelope_id=NEW.envelope_id AND followup_version=NEW.version AND state='pending';
END;
